markers.text: This is a one step entry to this restaurant
The sign indicating that this enterance is accessible is a bit faded, difficult to see/read
Sound Transit signage in middle of pathway in front of the door
This door is locked, cant collect data now
Obstacles here are part of T-Line stop infrastructure (ticketing machines, seating, signage, etc) but path in front and behind is clear
Several patches of dirt with trees in a row along middle of walkway, each are about 3’ x 4’ and about ten feet apart
The obstacle here is the light pole/walk signal
Obstacle is a small walk signal pole

All of the crossing markings on this intersection are a bit faded
All consist of parallel white lines with red brick in between to indicate crossing
There is a bus stop here on South side of island
Bus shelter has no glass or protection
Lowered curb is very uneven with broken concrete abd a large splotch of asphalt
